exposure: participation in the Maryland Perinatal-Neonatal Quality Care Collaborative (MDPQC)
outcome: Cesarean delivery rates for nulliparous term singleton vertex births
Cesarean delivery rates for nulliparous, term, singleton, vertex inductions
Adoption of policy and practice changes related to reducing primary cesarean deliveries
cohort: 31 birthing hospitals in Maryland participating in the MDPQC
finding: The MDPQC, which aimed to reduce primary cesarean deliveries, was associated with a statewide reduction in cesarean delivery rates for nulliparous, term, singleton, vertex births.
mod_finding: This study found that a collaborative quality improvement program (MDPQC) was associated with a statewide reduction in cesarean delivery rates for nulliparous, term, singleton, vertex births.
